title: Billing Calculation Memo: Estimated Water Consumption for a Missed Read Day — Utility Pass-Through Service
content:
**Calculation.** When a water submeter on a Utility Pass-Through Service account could not be read on its read day, the estimated water consumption for that read cycle is worked as follows. The estimate starts from the average consumption of the actual water reads taken in the last four months, a read counting as taken in the last four months when fewer than four whole months separate its read date from the handling date. That average is converted to the cycle being estimated by multiplying it by the days of service billed on the trash charge of the latest statement and dividing by 30. The estimated consumption is rounded half up to two decimal places of a thousand gallons once, on the final figure.

## The quantities

1. **Reads taken into the average** — water reads of the type "actual" whose read date lies fewer than 4 whole months before the handling date. Estimated reads, opening and final reads and verification re-reads are not actual reads and are not counted.
2. **Average** — the total consumption of those reads divided by their number.
3. **Days of service** — the days of service billed on the trash charge of the latest statement.
4. **Converted figure** — the average, times those days of service, divided by 30.
5. **Rounding** — half up to the hundredth of a thousand gallons, once, on the final figure; no intermediate figure is rounded.

## Counting four whole months (handling date 10 June, hypothetical)

| Read date of an actual water read | Whole months to 10 June | Taken in the last four months? |
|---|---|---|
| 11 February | 3 | Yes |
| 10 February | 4 | No |
| 22 May | 0 | Yes |

## Worked example (hypothetical account)

Handling date 10 June. Actual water reads: 22 February 4.10 kgal, 22 March 3.80 kgal, 22 April 4.40 kgal, 22 May 3.90 kgal. The latest statement's trash charge billed 31 days of service.

- Average: 4.10, 3.80, 4.40 and 3.90 total 16.20; divided by 4 reads is 4.05 kgal.
- Converted: 4.05 times 31 is 125.55; divided by 30 is 4.185.
- Rounded half up once: **4.19 kgal**.

Had the trash charge billed 30 days, the converted figure would be 4.05, recorded as 4.05 kgal.
